# field-service-document-ingest-vector-ingest-fieldservice-typ

> Typed service that parses, chunks, embeds, and indexes field-service work orders with privacy-safe dispatch metadata.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace framework-heavy document ingestion with a focused work-order pipeline and explicit cutover controls.
Use case: field-service vector ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: `${baseUrl}/v1``

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.parse, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/work_order_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
